name: Clayzo
summary: Free animation engine that lets coding agents like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor create motion graphics.
description: Clayzo is a free animation engine built for coding agents: you ask Claude Code, Codex or Cursor for motion graphics, product animations or interactive web animations, the agent writes them in code and checks every frame, and you export a video or play it live on the web or natively in Swift.

howToUse.title: Run `npx clayzo@latest init` in your project
howToUse.description: Run `npx clayzo@latest init` in your project
